verdict.rationale: The docs describe a public API surface for driving Elasticsearch programmatically: a REST API reference (the RRF link sits under /reference/elasticsearch/rest-apis), an inference API for endpoint configuration, index-mapping-driven ingest and query, and official client libraries for most popular languages. The OpenAPI probe found no spec at the tested elastic.co paths, but that only shows a machine-readable spec is absent there, not that the API is undocumented. missing for 10: direct evidence of the full REST API reference content, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven workflows.
